author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use a specific, semantically meaningful id type instead of a generic string or type for a field that identifies a domain entity.
fix_shape: Replace the generic/string type with a specific branded id type (e.g. ArtifactId).

author: wittjosiah
principle: Give an options/config parameter a default value so callers are not forced to pass an empty object.
fix_shape: Add a default value (e.g. `= {}`) to the options parameter instead of requiring callers to pass one.

author: thure
principle: Style conditional visual states with data-/aria- attribute selectors in CSS instead of computing the conditional classname in JS, and only mint a new semantic token once several places need it.
fix_shape: Move the conditional class into a data-attribute-driven CSS rule (e.g. data-active) rather than inline template logic.

author: thure
principle: Avoid arbitrary Tailwind values; express spacing and sizing with the design system's existing tokens.
fix_shape: Replace the arbitrary bracketed value (e.g. w-[12rem]) with the matching design-system token (e.g. is-48).

author: thure
principle: Use an existing semantic design token instead of a hardcoded color/utility class.
fix_shape: Swap the hardcoded className for the existing semantic token (e.g. text-subdued).

author: thure
principle: Before changing a shared/base style, verify the change looks correct in every component that consumes it.
fix_shape: Manually check (or screenshot) every consumer of the shared style before merging.

author: thure
principle: Use semantic HTML elements rather than generic divs, since replacing them reduces accessibility.
fix_shape:
Keep or restore the semantic tag (e.g.

) instead of substituting a non-semantic

.

author: thure
principle: Prefer binding keyboard handlers to keydown rather than keyup unless there is a documented reason to do otherwise.
fix_shape: Switch the handler from onKeyUp to onKeyDown, or add a comment explaining why keyup is required.

author: thure
principle: Do not wrap a className in a class-merging helper when there is nothing to merge.
fix_shape: Use a plain className string instead of calling mx()/classnames with a single argument.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not name or destructure a function parameter that the body never uses.
fix_shape: Drop the unused destructured parameter (or rename to `_`) from the function signature.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name a variable descriptively after the service/type it holds instead of an abbreviation.
fix_shape: Rename the abbreviated variable (e.g. svc) to a descriptive name matching its type.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a config pattern will be repeated across many packages, extract it into a small shared helper/DSL instead of duplicating the boilerplate per package.
fix_shape: Replace the ad hoc per-package config object with a call into a shared config-building helper.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a config pattern will be repeated across many packages, extract it into a small shared helper/DSL instead of duplicating the boilerplate per package.
fix_shape: Replace the ad hoc per-package config object with a call into a shared config-building helper.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When migrating to a new mechanism, preserve existing default behavior and let packages opt in incrementally rather than switching everyone over at once.
fix_shape: Gate the new behavior behind an option/env var so the default keeps matching prior behavior during the transition.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wrap a Promise-returning method in Effect rather than mixing raw-Promise APIs into an Effect-based service.
fix_shape: Change the method's return type from Promise<T> to Effect.Effect<T, E> and update the implementation accordingly.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a builder/factory method to assemble a set of services when the caller can compose the layers directly.
fix_shape: Remove the builder method and have call sites merge/provide the needed layers themselves.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Add a JSDoc comment to an identifier-typed parameter explaining what the identifier actually refers to.
fix_shape: Add a doc comment above the parameter stating what kind of id it is (e.g. deployment id vs object id).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Model an optional/not-found result as a typed error in the Effect error channel rather than returning void/undefined.
fix_shape: Change the return type from Effect<T | void> back to Effect<T, NotFoundError> and fail explicitly.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Document a multi-step resolution/fallback process with a JSDoc comment listing the order in which sources are tried.
fix_shape: Add a JSDoc comment enumerating the resolution steps in order above the function.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A cast used to force a return type to match hides a real service-requirement mismatch; provide the missing services inside the implementing layer instead of casting at the call site.
fix_shape: Remove the `as Effect.Effect<O>` cast and provide the required services from within the layer construction.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Model an optional/not-found result as a typed error in the Effect error channel rather than returning void/undefined.
fix_shape: Fail with a typed not-found error instead of returning without a value.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose a service's method as a standalone function via a helper like Effect.serviceFunction instead of requiring every caller to yield* the service first.
fix_shape: Wrap the service method with Effect.serviceFunction so it can be called directly.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use Effect.fnUntraced (not Effect.fn) inside tests since tracing is unnecessary there, and give Effect.fn an explicit name when it is used.
fix_shape: Swap Effect.fn for Effect.fnUntraced in test code, or pass a name string when Effect.fn is genuinely needed.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not leak an implementation detail of which backend serves a call into the caller-facing API; the API should abstract over the execution mechanism.
fix_shape: Remove the parameter that names the backend and let the callee decide internally which mechanism to use.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not leak an implementation detail of which backend serves a call into the caller-facing API; encode the routing information on the definition/metadata instead of a call-site parameter.
fix_shape: Move the backend-selecting id onto the definition's metadata rather than passing it as a call parameter.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When refactoring a shared executor, trim service requirements that were only needed by a caller that no longer needs them rather than letting them accrete.
fix_shape: Remove the now-unused service dependencies from the function's Effect requirements.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Extract repeated setup/boilerplate code (e.g. credential creation) into a shared helper function instead of inlining it at each call site.
fix_shape: Move the duplicated setup block into a named helper function and call it from each place.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Size a test's timeout to the actual cost of the path being exercised rather than giving every test the same large timeout.
fix_shape: Use a shorter timeout (or skip the slow path) when the test hits a cache/fixture instead of doing live generation.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Put a single shell command directly in the task/config definition instead of wrapping it in a separate script when the wrapper adds no value.
fix_shape: Inline the command as the task's script rather than delegating to an intermediate pnpm script.

author: thure
principle: Use existing semantic color tokens instead of raw Tailwind palette classes.
fix_shape: Replace the raw color class (e.g. text-blue-500) with the matching semantic token (e.g. text-blueText).

author: thure
principle: Use existing semantic color tokens instead of raw Tailwind palette classes.
fix_shape: Replace the raw color class with the matching semantic token, choosing the token whose hue actually matches the design intent.

author: thure
principle: Name callback props with the on{Noun}{Event} convention the codebase already follows (matching Radix's pattern).
fix_shape: Rename the callback prop to fit on{Noun}{Event} (e.g. onSpaceCreated -> onCreateSpace or the reverse, per convention).

author: thure
principle: Keep visually related components using the same design token instead of diverging without a stated reason.
fix_shape: Use the token already shared by sibling components (e.g. modalSurface) instead of introducing a different one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the test runner's parameterized-test helper (e.g. test.each) for a table of similar cases instead of a manual for-loop inside one test.
fix_shape: Replace the for-loop over test cases with test.each(cases)(...).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Model relationships between entities with the relation mechanism rather than reintroducing them as ad hoc struct fields.
fix_shape: Replace the ad hoc field-based representation with a Relation-based one, consistent with prior design decisions.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not conflate a remote resource's registry with local instances of the same concept; keep the registry scoped to its one source and merge in the other source at the consuming layer.
fix_shape: Leave the registry class as the API for the remote source only, and merge local (e.g. space-scoped) instances into the result via a hook at the UI layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Push the merging of related data sources into the shared hook that already owns that data, rather than duplicating the merge/dedup logic at each call site.
fix_shape: Move the extra query and dedup logic inside the hook and have callers just pass the extra parameter (e.g. space).

author: richburdon
principle: When a derived representation is always needed, store the canonical source and derive the other form on demand instead of persisting both independently.
fix_shape: Make the source (e.g. grammar string) optional and compute/store only the canonical derived form (e.g. the AST) from it.

author: richburdon
principle: Follow the codebase's established naming convention (e.g. a trailing underscore for the private schema paired with a public exported interface) consistently rather than introducing it ad hoc.
fix_shape: Confirm the underscore-suffix pattern is the agreed convention before using it, or align with whatever the established one is.

author: richburdon
principle: Do not prefix a variable name with 'new' when the prefix adds no disambiguating information.
fix_shape: Drop the 'new' prefix and name the variable after what it holds (e.g. queryString, query).

author: richburdon
principle: Do not introduce an intermediate variable to hold a value that can be destructured directly from the constructing call.
fix_shape: Destructure the needed field straight from the function call instead of assigning the whole result first.

author: richburdon
principle: Order Tailwind utility classes from most to least significant, and avoid overly specific/arbitrary numeric values when a coarser one would do.
fix_shape: Reorder the className string so the most significant class comes first, and question narrowly specific values like min-bs-10.

author: richburdon
principle: Compare against the library's own previous-state snapshot instead of manually tracking a prior value in a ref.
fix_shape: Diff against update.startState (or the equivalent built-in previous state) rather than a hand-maintained ref of the last value.

author: richburdon
principle: Group callback-typed props together (e.g. at the end of the list) in a props/type definition for consistency.
fix_shape: Reorder the union/prop list so callback members are grouped together.

author: richburdon
principle: Name a component after what it generally does, not the narrow context it was first written for, especially once it is reused beyond that context.
fix_shape: Rename the component to a general-purpose name (e.g. ObjectPicker) and relocate it if it is now used outside its original module.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the database object constructor (Obj.make) to create a database-backed object with schema/type/metadata, not the plain reactive wrapper meant for signals-only objects.
fix_shape: Replace `live(schema, values)` with `Obj.make(schema, values)` when the object is meant to be persisted to the database.

author: thure
principle: Access component styling through the theme function (tx) rather than importing and using individual theme objects directly.
fix_shape: Replace the direct import/use of the theme object (e.g. inputTheme.input(...)) with a tx('component.variant', ...) call.

author: thure
principle: Access component styling through the theme function (tx) rather than importing and using individual theme objects directly.
fix_shape: Replace the direct theme-object className call with tx('input.input', 'input--editor', { density, elevation }).

author: wittjosiah
principle: Factor a derived-state computation (e.g. building a filter/query from other state) out into its own hook instead of inlining it in the component body.
fix_shape: Extract the inline useMemo/useEffect logic into a named hook and call it from the component.

author: thure
principle: A component meant to be used like a common primitive (e.g. a text input) should own its layout so consumers do not need wrapper divs for ordinary use.
fix_shape: Move the layout/sizing concerns into the component itself rather than requiring callers to wrap it in extra divs.

author: richburdon
principle: End every comment with a period, so a clipped comment is still recognizable as complete.
fix_shape: Add the missing trailing period to the comment.

author: richburdon
principle: Always use braces for a conditional body, even a single-line one.
fix_shape: Wrap the single-statement if body in braces.

author: richburdon
principle: Add a Storybook story for a new UI component.
fix_shape: Add a .stories.tsx file exercising the new component.

author: richburdon
principle: Group callback-typed props together in a props/type definition for consistency.
fix_shape: Reorder the type's members so callback props are grouped together.

author: richburdon
principle: Group related option fields (e.g. everything prefixed create*) together in a type definition.
fix_shape: Reorder the type's members so related fields sit next to each other.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When splitting a field into a separate id and label, audit every filter/query call site, since queries must now reference the id rather than the label.
fix_shape: Update Filter/query call sites to filter on the new id field instead of the old label value.

author: thure
principle: Use the term the codebase already established for a concept (e.g. hue) instead of introducing a new synonym (e.g. Color) for the same thing.
fix_shape: Rename the new field/parameter to match the existing established term, or leave a TODO to do so.

author: richburdon
principle: Don't scatter ad hoc defensive-initialization patches for legacy or malformed persisted data at each call site; centralize repair/migration logic for each data type.
fix_shape: Introduce a single repair/migration function for the data type, invoked once, instead of a `??=` guard at every mutation site.

author: wittjosiah
principle: A dependency used only for local build/dev tooling belongs in devDependencies, not runtime dependencies.
fix_shape: Move the tooling-only package from dependencies to devDependencies across every package.json that has it wrong.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer the combined helper that creates and inserts an object in one call over separate construction and insertion steps.
fix_shape: Replace `Obj.make(...)` followed by a separate add call with the one-line `db.add(Obj.make(...))`.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a defensive fallback for a value whose absence would already fail an earlier assertion; it is dead code that suggests a state the types/logic already exclude.
fix_shape: Remove the `?? ''` (or similar) fallback and rely on the preceding invariant/assertion instead.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Use the shared sorting/ordering utility the framework already provides (e.g. Order from @dxos/echo) instead of reimplementing sort logic locally.
fix_shape: Replace the local reverse/sort useMemo with the shared Order helper.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Include a reactive value in a hook's dependency array even when you expect it not to change, rather than relying on that assumption and omitting it.
fix_shape: Add the value back into the dependency array instead of leaving it out.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When pinning a version or adding a workaround for a third-party tool's bug, leave a comment explaining why.
fix_shape: Add a comment above the pinned/worked-around line naming the bug it works around.

author: thure
principle: When a Radix .Trigger uses asChild, pass it a single actionable element directly (e.g. IconButton) rather than wrapping content in an extra intervening div.
fix_shape: Replace the wrapping div + asChild with IconButton directly as the trigger's child, or drop asChild and style the trigger itself.

author: thure
principle: A Surface with role='section' must be rendered as a direct child of StackItem.Root inside a vertical stack; it should not be wrapped in an arbitrary intermediate div.
fix_shape: Move the Surface to be a direct child of StackItem.Root instead of nesting it inside a styled div.

author: thure
principle: Wrap toolbar-like controls in the shared Toolbar.Root primitive instead of a bespoke container.
fix_shape: Replace the ad hoc wrapper with Toolbar.Root around the controls.

author: thure
principle: Never add an interceding div between a Radix .Trigger's asChild and its rendered element; pass the actionable component directly as the trigger's only child.
fix_shape: Remove the wrapping div and give asChild a single component (e.g. IconButton) as its child.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the shared resource-lifecycle wrapper the framework already provides to open/close a resource in Effect, instead of calling open()/close() manually.
fix_shape: Wrap the resource with the existing Resource-in-Effect helper instead of calling .open() directly.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Implement a lifecycle-bearing class using the codebase's established Resource pattern rather than a bespoke open()/close() implementation, for uniformity.
fix_shape: Extend/compose the shared Resource base instead of hand-writing open()/close() and manual invariant guards.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Extract a repeated open-on-mount/close-on-unmount pattern into a single shared hook instead of hand-rolling useMemo+useEffect for each lifecycle-bearing object.
fix_shape: Introduce a generic useResource(get, deps) hook that opens and closes the resource, and use it instead of ad hoc state+effect wiring.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Inside a task runner's own command, invoke the binary directly rather than routing it through the package manager's run command.
fix_shape: Drop the `pnpm` prefix from the moon task's command since moon already resolves the binary.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not leave a test's assertions commented out; a test without assertions on the outcome is not verifying anything.
fix_shape: Restore or add real assertions on the result instead of leaving them commented or absent.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Match a build/bundle target platform to the actual runtime the output will execute in, rather than defaulting to node/browser opportunistically.
fix_shape: Set the bundler's platform option to the value that matches the real deployment target (e.g. workers), not an environment heuristic.

author: richburdon
principle: Give a semantically meaningful string literal (e.g. a model identifier) a named type instead of leaving every occurrence as a bare string.
fix_shape: Introduce a ModelName (or similar) type/union and use it for the constant and the field it initializes.

author: richburdon
principle: Keep a group of semantically related fields ordered consistently with how the same fields appear in the canonical/base API.
fix_shape: Reorder the struct's fields to match the established order used elsewhere (e.g. system, prompt, model).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Extract repeated setup/boilerplate code into a shared helper instead of duplicating it at each call site.
fix_shape: Move the duplicated computation/invocation boilerplate into a named helper function or hook and call it from each place.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use a query's own built-in reactivity (its live results) instead of manually mirroring the query into a separate signal.
fix_shape: Subscribe to the query directly and read its reactive `objects`/results rather than copying values into a hand-maintained signal.

author: richburdon
principle: Mark a purely layout/wrapping element with role='none' so it does not pollute the accessibility tree.
fix_shape: Add role='none' to the wrapping div that exists only for layout.

author: wittjosiah
principle: In React code, import from the react-client package rather than the base client package, for consistency with the rest of the React-facing code.
fix_shape: Change the import source from @dxos/client/echo to the equivalent @dxos/react-client export.

author: wittjosiah
principle: A package should depend on the lowest-level package that provides what it needs rather than importing from a higher-level aggregating package.
fix_shape: Import the specific low-level echo/automerge API instead of re-exporting through the higher-level client package.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define an AI toolkit using the framework's declarative builder (Toolkit.make/Tool.make with parameters, success/failure schemas and declared dependencies) rather than hand-wiring the resolver and layer.
fix_shape: Rewrite the toolkit definition with Toolkit.make/Tool.make, declaring the tool's schema and dependencies instead of constructing it imperatively.

author: richburdon
principle: Name a query/accessor method to reflect exactly what it queries rather than giving it a generic overloaded name.
fix_shape: Rename the method to something specific like querySchema, or namespace it under an interim accessor object.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Name a returned API field after what it represents rather than after the implementation library that produced it.
fix_shape: Rename the field (e.g. rx -> objects, or add run) so the public shape reads in domain terms, not library terms.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not disable a feature by commenting its registration out; wire it so it can be toggled properly (e.g. with a no-op layer).
fix_shape: Replace the commented-out contribution with a real one backed by a no-op/empty layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the shared tracing helper to instrument an Effect call instead of manually assembling the tracing layers at each call site.
fix_shape: Replace the manual Layer.provideMerge tracing wiring with the existing traceCall pipe helper.

author: richburdon
principle: Prefer explicit named re-exports over a wildcard namespace re-export when only specific names need to be exposed.
fix_shape: Replace `export * as X from './types/X'` with `export { X, ... } from './types'`.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not export test-only utilities (such as a test service layer) from a package's main entrypoint.
fix_shape: move the test layer to a dedicated test subpath/entrypoint instead of the package root export.

author: richburdon
principle: Reuse an existing shared utility instead of writing a new local implementation of the same thing.
fix_shape: import and call the existing helper (e.g. a formatBytes in a common units module) instead of defining a duplicate.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Put a package's public type definitions in its api package rather than in a separate ad hoc types directory.
fix_shape: move the type module's contents into the existing api package and export from there.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Within a package, import its own modules with relative imports, never by importing the package's own published name.
fix_shape: replace the self-referential `@scope/pkg-name` import with a relative import path.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not leave a duplicate copy of a file/module behind when its contents were moved elsewhere; delete the stale one.
fix_shape: remove the now-redundant duplicate file.

author: richburdon
principle: Name a schema/data field for what it represents, not for an unrelated implementation concept such as a UI construct.
fix_shape: rename the field to reflect its actual meaning (e.g. inputSchema instead of formSchema).

author: richburdon
principle: Give a non-trivial exported function a short explanatory comment and name it with a precise action verb rather than a vague one like 'ensure'.
fix_shape: add a one-line doc comment and rename the function to a more specific verb (create/construct/validate/repair).

author: richburdon
principle: Give enum/constant string values that are self-descriptive on their own, not jargon that only makes sense in the circumstance that produced them.
fix_shape: rename the constant/value to something informative independent of context.

author: richburdon
principle: Build a single object up front and pass it through a common, uniform interface shared across similar adapters, rather than passing separate destructured fields per adapter.
fix_shape: construct one object and pass it into the shared container interface instead of individual props.

author: richburdon
principle: Keep an object factory function synchronous; do not make it async merely to perform an internal side effect like schema registration — hoist that out to the caller.
fix_shape: extract the async step (e.g. schema registration) into an explicit input the caller awaits and passes in, keeping make() sync.

author: richburdon
principle: Use a generic, unbranded local variable name (e.g. object) when its specific type is already clear from context, instead of a type-specific name.
fix_shape: rename the variable to the generic term.

author: richburdon
principle: Inline a single-use helper's body at its call site instead of naming an extra intermediate when it does not hurt readability.
fix_shape: inline the helper call directly where it is used.

author: richburdon
principle: Inline a value that is only used once instead of assigning it to an intermediate variable first.
fix_shape: fold the intermediate variable's construction directly into the call that uses it.

author: richburdon
principle: Resolve a user-facing string through translation/i18n at runtime rather than hardcoding a fixed literal that will be displayed to the user.
fix_shape: look up the string via the translation mechanism at render/use time instead of embedding it as a static annotation value.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When defining a Schema for a type identified by a runtime type guard, use Schema.declare with the predicate rather than hand-composing Schema.Any with custom refinement logic.
fix_shape: replace the hand-built Schema.Any.pipe(...) with Schema.declare(isX).

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Do not name a build/bundler entrypoint 'index' when it will be wrapped by additional runtime code around it; name it to reflect that it is not the top-level entry.
fix_shape: pick an entry point name that signals it is wrapped rather than the literal program entry.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Keep two closely coupled types/concepts (a definition and the protocol that wraps it) defined together rather than splitting them across modules in a way that obscures the relationship.
fix_shape: fold the closely related type into the same module/namespace it is wrapped by.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: A function's declared return type must accurately describe what it actually returns, not a related-but-different type.
fix_shape: give the function a return type that reflects the real shape it produces.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Use the project's structured logger, not console.log, and avoid logging on every iteration of a loop or callback where it would spam output.
fix_shape: replace console.log with the log utility and gate/throttle it so it does not fire on every tick.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Log routine, frequent, or internal-detail events at a lower level than info (e.g. debug/verbose), reserving info for meaningful events.
fix_shape: lower the log call's level from info to debug/trace.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a method needs to support a new kind of input, add it as an explicit option and let the implementation decide how to use it, rather than widening the parameter type to a union of unrelated shapes.
fix_shape: add a dedicated option (e.g. a query option) instead of accepting `A | B` as the primary parameter.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Handle HTTP client errors using Effect's native typed-error mechanisms rather than throwing a plain Error from inside an Effect.gen block.
fix_shape: use the platform HTTP client's typed error handling instead of `throw new Error(...)`.

author: richburdon
principle: Before writing new inline logic, check whether an existing helper function already does it and reuse that instead.
fix_shape: call the existing helper instead of re-implementing its logic inline.

author: richburdon
principle: In tests, use the structured logger rather than console.log so output can be filtered or turned off.
fix_shape: replace console.log with the log utility in the test.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Consolidate a legacy or duplicate type alias into the single canonical unified type rather than keeping both around.
fix_shape: remove the legacy alias and use the canonical type (e.g. Obj.Any) in its place.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not keep a method that duplicates a standalone utility function already providing the same capability; use the standalone function.
fix_shape: remove the duplicate method and call the standalone utility instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Migrate call sites onto the single canonical construction API rather than leaving them on a legacy equivalent.
fix_shape: replace the legacy constructor/helper with the canonical one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer the canonical public API type definition over an internal/duplicate equivalent, unless a circular dependency forces the internal one.
fix_shape: collapse the duplicate internal definition and reference the canonical API type instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Define the symbols and interfaces describing a single data shape together in one place rather than scattering them across files.
fix_shape: co-locate the related symbol/interface declarations in the module that owns the data shape.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove an abstraction that a model simplification has made obsolete rather than keeping it alongside the new, simpler model.
fix_shape: delete the now-unnecessary type/interface once its underlying distinction no longer exists.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Colocate related symbol/type definitions with the object model they belong to instead of splitting them into separate files.
fix_shape: move the split-out definitions back next to the model definition they describe.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When importing many symbols that would collide with local names, use a namespace import instead of renaming each one individually with a suffix.
fix_shape: replace `import { x as x$, y as y$ } from './mod'` with `import * as mod from './mod'` and reference `mod.x`.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a package's README up to date with the list of its exported public APIs.
fix_shape: add/update a section in the README enumerating the exported APIs.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Require a function's input type to already satisfy its invariants (e.g. an already-constructed, well-formed object) rather than accepting a weaker type and patching properties into the return type.
fix_shape: tighten the parameter type to the already-valid type and return the same type unchanged.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A generic API operating over a type hierarchy (e.g. Obj | Relation) should bound and default its type parameter over the full union, not just one member, unless intentionally restricted.
fix_shape: widen the generic bound/default to include every member of the hierarchy the API is meant to support.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer a plain readonly property over a getter accessor for a value that involves no computation.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not wrap a call in an external cancellation/context helper when the callee itself already accepts a context and can handle cancellation internally.
fix_shape: move the cancellation handling into the function that owns the context instead of wrapping every caller

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a separate lookup method when an existing method's contract already covers returning the existing instance; extend or reuse it instead.
fix_shape: fold the new behavior into the existing method's options rather than adding a parallel method

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose state that UI needs to observe reactively as a reactive atom/signal, not a one-shot Effect or promise-returning getter.
fix_shape: back the accessor with an Atom instead of a plain Effect call

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid asserting on an exact boundary value in a test when a less precise value exercises the same behavior more robustly.
fix_shape: advance/assert past the boundary by a safe margin instead of the exact edge value

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse a common/shared type for a recurring cross-cutting concept (e.g. an actor/author field) instead of an ad hoc string field.
fix_shape: replace the ad hoc field with the shared common type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a field duplicating something the platform's object metadata already provides (e.g. tags on ECHO object meta).
fix_shape: remove the redundant field and use the platform-provided one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: An operation input that identifies an existing object should take a typed Ref rather than a bare id string.
fix_shape: change the input field's type to a Ref instead of a string id

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A setter function must not call the object's own batched-update primitive internally; let the caller wrap multiple field writes in one update call themselves.
fix_shape: remove the internal update()/batch wrapper from the setter and let callers do the wrapping

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Place an object-mutation API in the namespace that owns objects, not a more general entity namespace that also covers relations and types.
fix_shape: move the functions into the more specific owning namespace

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Perform bulk background data-processing (like deduplication merges) in the worker/host process that owns the data rather than synchronously on the client.
fix_shape: move the batch operation into the worker/host path instead of a client-side pass

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not query or scan an entire space/collection when a narrower targeted query can serve the same need; a full scan is a performance pitfall.
fix_shape: replace the full-space scan with a filtered/targeted query

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Document the precise meaning and lifecycle of a durable state row (what creates it, what clears it, what its presence implies) directly in the comment rather than leaving it to be inferred.
fix_shape: add the explicit lifecycle explanation to the comment

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name a directory/module to match what it actually exports — a capitalized name implies a public namespace-export module, so a plain re-export helper should be lowercase and live under a common/internal location.
fix_shape: rename the directory to lowercase and move it under the common/internal location

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A consuming package should not reach into another package's internal module; either move the logic into the package that needs it or expose a public API for it.
fix_shape: relocate the code so it no longer needs the internal import, or add a public API entry point

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Add logging for a significant success path (a state-changing operation like a merge), not only for failures.
fix_shape: add log statements recording what changed (e.g. ids merged/removed) on the success path

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Test a distributed convergence property (like a merge across replicating peers) with an actual multi-peer integration test, not only single-peer unit tests.
fix_shape: add a two-peer replication test that demonstrates the system settling to the converged state

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Question whether an explicit client-triggered operation is still needed once an automatic background mechanism already covers the same job.
fix_shape: remove the explicit pass if the automatic path already achieves the same result, or justify why both are needed

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not introduce a new interface/abstraction layer over an existing concrete class when a small, narrowly-scoped new class can do the new thing on its own.
fix_shape: leave the existing class unchanged and add a focused new class for the new behavior instead of generalizing behind an interface

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A deferred callback (like an alarm/timer handler) should not inherit the calling fiber's context; give it a context owned by its own scheduler so contexts do not grow unbounded through recursive scheduling chains.
fix_shape: fork the callback with a fresh/owned context rather than the caller's inherited one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A public application-facing interface should not import types straight from the wire/protocol layer, and should take an options object rather than positional parameters.
fix_shape: define local option types instead of depending on protocol wire types directly in the signature

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not build a façade/adapter that hides a distinction (e.g. local vs remote execution) that consuming code actually needs to be aware of to behave correctly.
fix_shape: remove the adapter and have callers branch explicitly on the distinction it was hiding

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not call a deprecated function; remove the call and adjust the surrounding logic rather than keep relying on it.
fix_shape: remove the deprecated call and its now-unneeded branch

author: wittjosiah
principle: A diagram that encodes meaning through color must include a legend explaining what each color represents.
fix_shape: add a legend to the diagram

author: wittjosiah
principle: Name a concept after what it generally is, not after its first or most common use case, so the name still fits as usage broadens.
fix_shape: rename the concept to something that covers its full range of uses

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Represent a new kind of completion event using the existing message/content-block shape (e.g. a synthetic text block) rather than inventing a new event type for it.
fix_shape: wrap the payload as the existing block/message type instead of adding a new event kind

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid a global mutable registry for per-object bookkeeping when a more local mechanism (e.g. a hidden property on the object itself) can serve the same purpose.
fix_shape: store the data on the object instead of a global map, and drop unneeded dispatch abstraction

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not reintroduce an abstraction (like dispatch through a mutable handler slot) that was deliberately removed for simplicity or performance.
fix_shape: keep the simplified fixed-handler design rather than re-adding dispatch indirection

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep package.json export-condition keys consistent across every package (e.g. always map `import` to the build default) rather than varying the convention per package.
fix_shape: align the export condition key/order to match the repo-wide convention

author: dmaretskyi
principle: After replacing a mechanism, scan for and remove the now-dead code from the superseded approach rather than leaving it alongside the replacement.
fix_shape: delete the leftover dead code the refactor made obsolete

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Include the enclosing scope's id (e.g. spaceId) as a leading column in an index/key meant to be unique or queried only within that scope, to avoid cross-scope collisions.
fix_shape: add the scope id as the first column of the composite index

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep an implementation-internal capability (like arming a process's own alarm) off the public handle/API; do not expose internal scheduling mechanics to external callers.
fix_shape: remove the public method and keep the capability internal to the owning component

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not maintain two parallel context-propagation mechanisms (a custom Context object and Effect's own context); use Effect's context exclusively once Effect is adopted.
fix_shape: pass the value through Effect's context instead of a separate Context parameter

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not put application-specific behavior (e.g. an app's login-page helper) in a shared SDK/config package; keep it in the app that needs it.
fix_shape: move the helper into the consuming app's own package

author: wittjosiah
principle: When an architecture change removes the need for a config field/message, remove it entirely as part of the same change rather than leaving it in place unused.
fix_shape: delete the now-unnecessary config message/field

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not store on each record data that can be derived by a resolver from its other fields (e.g. an endpoint derivable from provider + id); derive it instead of hand-populating a redundant field.
fix_shape: remove the extra field and compute it via a resolver lookup keyed on the existing fields

author: wittjosiah
principle: Schedule a timeout through the codebase's context-aware scheduling helper rather than a raw setTimeout, so it is automatically cancelled when the owning context disposes.
fix_shape: replace the raw setTimeout with the ctx-scoped scheduler helper

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a test's per-case data-fetching logic in the test body, not duplicated inside each scorer; give scorers a reusable, declarative way to query and assert.
fix_shape: move db queries to the test body, pass results to scorers, and build a shared scorer helper/DSL.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: When a bug's root cause is a diagnosed and already-fixed-upstream issue, wait for that fix to ship rather than layering additional client-side workarounds that have already been shown ineffective.
fix_shape: revert/avoid the added mitigation; document the true root cause and link the upstream fix instead of retrying client-side.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: When removing a mechanism, also remove the code that existed only to support it, rather than leaving it dead.
fix_shape: delete the now-unused constant/helper alongside the mechanism it supported.

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Record the diagnosed root cause of a measurement or experiment in the docs, not just the raw null result, so the next reader does not have to re-derive it.
fix_shape: add a short explanation of the cause and link the upstream issue/fix next to the measurement.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When introducing a better replacement for an internal API you own end to end, make the change breaking and remove the old path rather than keeping both as optional.
fix_shape: delete the old method/overload and update all call sites to the new one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reference another entity by a Ref rather than a raw id, and add a test that the consuming path dereferences it correctly.
fix_shape: change the field's type to Ref<T> and cover ref resolution with a test.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose test-observable state (e.g. captured trace messages) through an Effect Layer plus a Context tag the test can request, rather than an ad hoc closure-based collector.
fix_shape: wrap the collector in a Layer keyed by a Context.Tag with a typed accessor.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse a shared test helper/service across every suite that needs the same behavior instead of re-implementing it per file.
fix_shape: import and use the shared test service in the other test suites.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a cache in front of an operation that is already cheap; do the direct computation instead.
fix_shape: remove the cache map and perform the plain transform inline.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove small single-use helper functions and inline their logic instead of adding indirection for its own sake.
fix_shape: delete the helper functions and write their bodies inline at the call site.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't add explanatory comments that just restate configuration already legible from the code/name; keep comments only where they carry reasoning the code can't express.
fix_shape: delete the unnecessary comment.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A batch operation's 'success' must never silently discard entries that failed; surface every failure to the caller.
fix_shape: collect the failed results from a settled Promise.all/batch and propagate or report them instead of swallowing them.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't implement ordered, sequential processing with a hand-rolled promise chain (racy around lifecycle); use a purpose-built ordering primitive.
fix_shape: replace the manual promise-chaining queue with a TransformStream (or equivalent) that processes items strictly in order.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer native web platform APIs over Node-specific ones in code that must run in non-Node environments.
fix_shape: replace Node Buffer usage with the equivalent web API (e.g. Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Never use a fixed sleep/timeout to wait for async state to settle in a test; wait on a deterministic signal instead.
fix_shape: replace the sleep with awaiting the actual condition/event rather than a fixed delay.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Process a collection of async work with a bounded-concurrency combinator rather than an unbounded sequential loop.
fix_shape: replace the for-loop with Effect.forEach(items, fn, { concurrency: N }).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't introduce a second, ad hoc piece of lifecycle/torn-down state when the class already owns one lifecycle mechanism; reuse and normalize naming instead of adding a parallel flag.
fix_shape: derive the state from (or normalize naming with) the existing base-class lifecycle instead of a new private flag.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a type cast to work around a type mismatch; find or build a type-safe way to satisfy the signature.
fix_shape: remove the cast and adjust generics/types so the call is properly typed.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wrap a stateful message-channel pattern (subscribe/post) in its own small utility class with named handlers and post methods, rather than scattering raw channel/message-type usage inline.
fix_shape: extract a class encapsulating the channel, listener registration, and message posting.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Give a new, logically separate store/index its own class/module rather than folding it into an unrelated existing index's code.
fix_shape: create a dedicated class for the new store in the appropriate directory, with its own name/cursor, instead of embedding it in an unrelated file.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse an existing generic mechanism already built for a need (e.g. a cursors table for re-indexing) rather than introducing extra machinery.
fix_shape: drive the new behavior through the existing shared table/mechanism instead of a bespoke one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: An eval or test exercising an agent end-to-end should drive the real agent doing the real task, not a scripted stand-in, and should verify specific tool calls by inspecting the actual invocation transcript.
fix_shape: replace the scripted flow with a real agent run guided by a prescriptive script, and assert on parsed transcript tool calls.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't write a custom helper that duplicates behavior an official/library API already provides; use the official API directly.
fix_shape: delete the local helper and call the library's built-in function instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Provide a type-safe builder API for composing layers/services, rather than requiring callers to hand-assemble them.
fix_shape: add a typed factory function (e.g. `layer({...})`) that returns the composed Layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid issuing two round-trip queries when the common case can be satisfied by one.
fix_shape: restructure the query so the common path does a single statement (e.g. an upsert) instead of a check-then-write.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't widen a class's public/constructor API just to make it injectable for tests; that indicates the wrong seam.
fix_shape: find another way to test (e.g. a lower-level constructor or test-only factory) rather than adding a test-only optional constructor param.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Give parallel/analogous methods the same return type/shape so callers can treat them uniformly.
fix_shape: align the new method's return type with the existing analogous one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Inject a shared dependency once through the constructor and store it as a field, rather than threading it as a parameter through every method.
fix_shape: accept the dependency in the constructor and reference the stored field in methods instead of passing it on each call.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Make a new secondary mechanism implement the same interface and reuse the same shared management code as existing instances of its kind, rather than growing a bespoke one-off implementation.
fix_shape: have the new component implement the shared interface and delegate to the common cursor-management code.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose a new drain/flush behavior as an option on the existing flush entrypoint, not a separate method, and cover it with a test.
fix_shape: add an options flag to the existing API and add tests exercising it.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't wrap Effect-based code in a plain class that mixes Promise-based glue; use the existing compositional Effect API so the code stays uniform with its surroundings.
fix_shape: delete the class and build the equivalent behavior using the Effect layer composition API.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't introduce a named constant for a literal used only to avoid retyping it, when it adds no clarity or type safety.
fix_shape: remove the constant and use the literal value directly at each use.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't perform expensive maintenance work implicitly inside a query/read path; make the caller explicitly trigger it through a dedicated API.
fix_shape: remove the implicit drain from the read path and add an explicit flush method the caller invokes when needed.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't expose test-only seams as constructor parameters; find a design that needs no injectable-for-tests escape hatch.
fix_shape: remove the optional constructor param and restructure so the component needs no test-only injection point.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When building a typed composition API, also expose a way for consumers to resolve the built result via a tag/service, not just a way to build it.
fix_shape: add a Context tag/service export alongside the builder function.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep an Effect-based module's public API entirely in Effect; don't mix Promise-returning methods into an Effect codebase.
fix_shape: convert the Promise-returning methods to Effect and update call sites.

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't leave excessive/low-value explanatory comments in code meant to land; keep only comments that carry real information.
fix_shape: trim the comments down to what's necessary before merging.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Normalize a composite/encoded value into its own explicit columns rather than packing it into a single opaque field, and add a column to record provenance/source explicitly instead of inferring it.
fix_shape: split the packed field into separate typed columns and add an explicit source/provenance column.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Let the consumer derive its own keys/derived data from the raw payload instead of having the producer pre-compute and pass them separately.
fix_shape: pass the raw data and have the consumer extract what it needs, dropping the separately precomputed argument.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add another ad hoc hash/utility implementation; consolidate on one shared implementation in a common utility package.
fix_shape: replace the local implementation with (or move it to) a single shared implementation in the common util package, and update other call sites to use it.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Model a new execution mode as just another step type the existing step-execution loop can run, rather than special-casing it as a separate branch or path.
fix_shape: add a new step kind to the existing step union and route it through the same executor loop.

author: wittjosiah
principle: A test that only checks a check exists and is wired up isn't enough; assert on the actual behavior the check is meant to catch.
fix_shape: add assertions that exercise the real behavior, not just presence/association.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Put logic in the module that already owns that responsibility rather than growing a parallel copy elsewhere, and pass configuration through the constructor rather than ad hoc options.
fix_shape: move the logic into the module that owns it and accept its config via constructor params.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Treat a new execution mode as another instance of the existing step abstraction, not a special-cased branch alongside it.
fix_shape: route the new mode through the same step-execution mechanism as every other step.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Thread configuration through explicit constructor params at the lower level, sourced from a proper config option higher up the stack, not an environment variable read inline.
fix_shape: replace the env-var lookup with a constructor parameter, resolved by the caller from the shared config.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a new method that duplicates an existing one's job; route through the existing one and remove the redundant addition.
fix_shape: delete the new method and call the existing equivalent instead.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid keeping two parallel representations of the same concept; collapse them into one representation that captures the variation as data.
fix_shape: merge the two plan fields/types into a single plan representation.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't organize modules by syntactic kind (tags vs events); organize by subsystem/domain with real interface modules, so a real circular dependency isn't masked by type-only imports.
fix_shape: group tags/interfaces/events for each subsystem into one module per subsystem instead of one file per kind.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A low-level component driven by constructor params should not read environment variables itself; resolve environment-derived config at a higher layer and pass it down.
fix_shape: remove the env var read from the low-level module and pass the resolved value in via constructor params.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a new public method to express a variant when an existing constructor/param already declares it; keep one consistent API surface.
fix_shape: remove the extra public method and drive the behavior from the constructor param already recorded.
